description: One-click DNS setup for sending transactional email through Bytesms (in-house SMTP relays in several regions): a DKIM TXT record, a CNAME record pointing the return-path subdomain (default send, customer-chosen) to the Bytesms return-path host of the domain's sending region (for example mta.bytesms.com or mta-ap-southeast-1.bytesms.com; it carries SPF and routes bounces, so the apex SPF record is left untouched) and a DMARC record that sends aggregate reports to Bytesms.
variableDescription: dkimselector: the DKIM selector shown on the Bytesms domain page (default bytesms). dkimkey: the DKIM public key (base64 SPKI, the p= value). rpsubdomain: the return-path subdomain label shown on the Bytesms domain page (default send; a single DNS label). mtahost: the Bytesms return-path target host for the domain's sending region (always a host under bytesms.com, e.g. mta.bytesms.com, mta-ap-southeast-1.bytesms.com, mta-eu-central-1.bytesms.com). dmarcrua: the Bytesms mailbox that receives DMARC aggregate reports (always an address under bytesms.com, e.g. dmarc@reports.bytesms.com).
